about: The Community Hub catalog: launchers, modules and themes. Every entry is reviewed by pull request and checked by tools/cyhu.py catalog validate. Listing an entry is not an endorsement, and no listed developer has endorsed or partnered with CleanYourHeadUnit.

recommended.why: Turns the screen into a classic car stereo, with every hardware and steering-wheel key mappable.
Control the unit from your phone's browser. Built for Android TV today; automotive support is planned.
Send music, maps and APKs from a phone or computer to the head unit over Wi-Fi, without a cable, account or internet.

items.name: RetroDeck
items.description: A virtual car stereo for Android head units: 18 vintage and modern single-DIN and double-DIN faceplates, music playback, live visualizers, vehicle branding and badges, dash illumination, a start-up melody box, and every hardware and steering-wheel key mappable.

reports: Tested by its developer on an Android TV (Android 14) at 1920x1080 and 1920x720; no car head unit report yet.

warnings: Not yet reported on a car head unit.

items.name: Webmote
items.description: A remote control served by the device itself: open a page on your phone, pair with the PIN on screen, and use the D-pad, apps, keyboard and media keys. Local network only.

reports: The current release is for Android TV and Google TV.

warnings: The current release is for Android TV and Google TV, not head units.
It works through an accessibility service; CleanYourHeadUnit never turns that on for you.

items.name: LocalSend
items.description: Share files between nearby devices over the local network: phones, computers and the head unit. No account, no internet, no cable; transfers are encrypted.

reports: Not yet reported on a car head unit.

warnings: Official sources: Google Play or F-Droid (both pick the right build for the unit), or the GitHub releases. The GitHub release has one APK per processor type: pick the one that matches the unit's processor (shown in Diagnostics), for example arm32v7 for a 32-bit unit and arm64v8 for a 64-bit one.
Needs Android 7.0 or newer; LocalSend 1.17.0 is the last version for Android 5 and 6. Check the real Android version: many units claim a newer one.
The unit and the other device must be on the same Wi-Fi.

items.name: KITT Launcher
items.description: A Knight Rider-inspired car launcher with an OBD-II dashboard, an AI co-pilot (your own Gemini or Perplexity key), map search with spoken directions, a browser and the red scanner light. Portrait edition, built for 12.1-inch vertical head units.
items.license: Proprietary, free to download and use (all rights reserved, source not published)
warnings: Closed source. CleanYourHeadUnit links to and downloads from the developer's own releases page only; it never mirrors or repackages the app.
Asks for location, microphone and Bluetooth permissions; it has its own updater.
